title: Chart
description: One deck chart: a kind and its data. This is the language-neutral contract of the chart grammar. Every kind draws as a native, editable PowerPoint chart; the HTML and pptx renderers must implement every kind listed here. The renderers also check per-kind series and category counts, which this schema does not repeat.

oneOf.title: Line
oneOf.description: Change over time. Native pptx LINE_MARKERS, direct; the reference is an extra series.

oneOf.title: Diverging bar
oneOf.description: Gain and loss by item. Native pptx BAR_CLUSTERED, direct.

oneOf.title: Waterfall
oneOf.description: Bridge between two totals. Native pptx COLUMN_STACKED with a hidden base series: a trick, because python-pptx cannot write the Office 2016 waterfall.

oneOf.title: 100% stacked bar
oneOf.description: Part of a whole. Native pptx BAR_STACKED_100, direct.

oneOf.title: Column
oneOf.description: Compare a few items. Native pptx COLUMN_CLUSTERED, direct.

series.description: Named series as [name, values]; each series has one value per category.

unit.description: Unit of the values, such as % or k orders.

reference.description: Value of a gray reference line, such as a target.

highlight.description: Index of the highlighted category; -1 for none.
